author: ques
body:
SpankySpade was spawnkilling me in a game of Nexus. In the previous map, he and Suli7 spawnkilled me and my teammate, but I only got screenies of SpankySpade sapwnkilling me due to the fact that Suli7 left. 

I verbally asked that he stop spawnkilling, yet he continued.
I ask that you guys find an appropriate punishment for his actions.

Screenshots:
http://imgur.com/a/rGTlB
